comments.author: Junchul
comments.body:
Why can't you change the name of these things?
It's terribly confusing and hard to find the things you need if they keep having names like this for ages.

comments.author: Sakura
comments.body: You (the poster) can update the name, but the updated name has to be manually changed by the site admins. Considering how some quests have been utterly defaced by spambots in the past, it's a necessary inconvenience.
